lines.en: - You can't call a time out!
- Oh, I've got to do it!
- Uh, we have an unofficial time out.
- Okay, that girl is trying to kill me.
- I thought she was gonna go easy on you.
- I don't know what she's doing!
Remember how you promised to go easy on me
- Shea hanging on to the left leg of the champion!
- I don't think we've seen this technique before.
- Go, go, go, go, go, go!
- Mark's trying to shake Shea off her leg,
but Shea is hanging on for dear life!
- Come on, come on, come on, come on!
- Will someone prize this girl off her leg so I can punch her?
- Carly, only 10 seconds left in the round.
- Eight more seconds, and Carly Shea will be the first girl
to ever last a full round with Shelby Marks.
- In five, four, three, two, one!
